Campus Ledger

Screen by screen design

Every screen of the Student Management System for Admin, Teacher and Student, in light and dark themes on desktop, tablet and mobile. Use the switch at the top for the theme and the buttons on each card for the device.

Section 1

Public pages

Shared header and footer on every page, so the site feels like one product.

Home

Landing page: hero with a live product preview and rotating role word, stats, interactive Admin / Teacher / Student tabs, features, steps, FAQ and call to action.

Log in

Clean form on the left with a show / hide password toggle, and a live student-view preview on the right.

Sign up

Students or teachers pick a role, then fill name, email and password in two columns.

404 page

Friendly message with a clear way back to home (and to the dashboard when signed in).

Section 2

Validation and errors

Same inline error style, message wording and colours everywhere.

Login: required fields

Empty submit shows a message under each field.

Login: wrong password

Generic, clear message so accounts cannot be guessed.

Signup: validation

Teacher role selected, every required field flagged at once.

Mobile menu

Menu on phones with links and the two auth buttons.

Section 3

Admin

Manages the system and its users.

Admin: overview

Headline numbers and the list of teachers waiting for approval.

Admin: users

Search and filter by role or status. Approve, disable, change role or delete.

Admin: students

Every student record, with edit, results and delete (delete is admin only).

Section 4

Teacher

Works with students.

Teacher: overview

Student and result counts plus the most recently added students.

Teacher: students

Add and edit students and open their results. No delete for teachers.

Section 5

Student

Uses the system for their own information.

Student: overview

Own profile, overall average, best subject and results table.

Student: my profile

Read-only record plus a form for the only fields a student may change.

Section 6

Dialogs and feedback

Confirmations, forms in dialogs, and success messages use one consistent pattern.

Success toast

Shown after login, save, approve and delete.

Account menu

Name, email, role badge, Dashboard and Sign out.

Change role

Admin picks a new role for a user.

Delete confirmation

Every delete asks first and names what will be lost.

Add student: validation

Errors appear under each field inside the dialog.

Add student: filled form

Two columns on desktop, one on phones (dialog becomes a bottom sheet).

Confirm before saving

Saving a student record asks for confirmation.

Student results

Add a result with marks validation, and see or delete existing results.

Screens captured from the running app. Font: Bricolage Grotesque. Teal with a mint highlight and soft animated school-themed backgrounds.
